verdict.rationale: React components combine their own logic and appearance in one unit (react-docs-11) and return what should appear on screen (react-docs-24). Markup is written in JSX, a JavaScript syntax extension (react-docs-2), so markup and rendering logic sit together in plain JavaScript. Missing for 10: any evidence on how CSS/styling is co-located in components, explicit evidence of how closely JSX matches familiar HTML, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the authoring experience.
